why: the zero-initialiser of `rclc_polling_subscription_t`, in rcl's `rcl_get_zero_initialized_*` shape. RFC-0022's polling tier, as its own type since phase-487 W1 (RFC-0096 D9, the C amendment). Nothing dispatches a polled subscription, so it has no arena slot and keeps its subscriber inline. rclcpp has no counterpart because its executor always owns dispatch; the C++ twin is `nros::PollSubscription<M>`, the Rust one `create_polling_subscription`.
